issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 15.7% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Munich plant pays 15.7% premium above best-plant pricing across 238 materials from Meridian Industrial GmbH, resulting in $5,290,985 excess spend over the trailing 12 months. Root cause is lack of price harmonization and absence of a global purchasing agreement in SAP S/4HANA, allowing plant-level pricing divergence.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate price benchmarking analysis across all plants for the 238 materials from Meridian Industrial GmbH to identify best-plant pricing and validate the $5,290,985 savings opportunity
Negotiate global pricing agreement with Meridian Industrial GmbH based on best-plant rates, targeting elimination of the 15.7% premium for Munich plant
Create global outline agreement in SAP S/4HANA (ME31L) with harmonized pricing for all 238 materials, superseding plant-level pricing
Update info records (ME11/ME12) and source lists (ME01) in SAP for Munich plant to enforce global agreement pricing and block local PO creation outside agreement
Implement approval workflow in SAP for any Munich plant purchase requisitions for these 238 materials that exceed global agreement pricing by >2%

plan.expected_impact: Elimination of $5,290,985 annual excess spend through price harmonization to best-plant rates across 238 materials at Munich plant
kpis: Average price premium reduction from 15.7% to 0% for Munich plant vs. best plant
Annual savings realization of $5,290,985 tracked monthly
100% PO compliance to global agreement pricing for 238 materials within 90 days
Percentage of spend under global agreement (target: 100% of Meridian Industrial GmbH spend)
risks: Meridian Industrial GmbH may resist global pricing negotiation, requiring escalation or alternative sourcing strategy
Munich plant may have legitimate service level or delivery requirement differences justifying premium pricing
Implementation delays across SAP master data may allow continued premium pricing leakage
Other plants may require price increases if Munich volumes or specifications differ materially
erp_actions: Create global outline agreement in SAP S/4HANA (ME31L) for 238 materials with best-plant pricing
Update purchasing info records (ME12) for Munich plant to reference global agreement and mark local records for deletion
Create source list entries (ME01) for all 238 materials at Munich plant pointing exclusively to global agreement
Configure release strategy in SAP for Munich plant PRs exceeding global pricing by >2% threshold
Set purchasing value key in SAP plant parameters to enforce source list requirement for these materials
